blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Trial Judges League Inc. (PTJLI) has condemned the killing of Basilan Regional Trial Court (RTC) Judge Joseph M. Wee Sit, calling for an immediate and impartial investigation and stronger security measures for members of the judiciary. In a statement, the group described the killing as an attack on judicial independence and the administration of justice, stressing that judges must be able to perform their duties without fear of violence or intimidation. Wee Sit, 38, presiding judge of RTC Branch 2 in Isabela City, Basilan, was shot along Tumaga-Putik Road in Zamboanga City at around 5:25 a.m. […]...
